title: Commercial mining pilot tests of the SAR technique under NDA

tellings.quote: I did a lot of pilot tests with companies. Uh-huh. And uh more than 100% successful.

plain: A radar imaging method used to look deep underground, said to have revealed structures beneath the pyramids of Egypt, has also been tried out by mining companies, according to the researcher behind it, Filippo Biondi. The method uses SAR, synthetic aperture radar, a way of building pictures from radar signals. Biondi says he ran many private trial tests with companies under secrecy agreements and that they were "more than 100% successful," which he offers as proof that the method really works.
